name: iq
description: Teach a coding agent to use the iq CLI (agent-native workspace search) by default over grep/find/Glob, plus session recall: past-session topic→file search and mid-point session forking, suggested automatically on a matching first prompt. Ships the iq skill, a SessionStart nudge + transcript ingest, and a UserPromptSubmit matcher. Requires the iq binary — install with `npm i -g @intentic/iq`.
